description: This Java class 'LogUtil' provides utility methods for logging, specifically for enhancing MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries with correlation IDs and custom fields, and for managing MDC state in conjunction with Akka actors and SLF4J logging framework.

classes.name: LogUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing logging MDC entries, especially correlation IDs, in an Akka and SLF4J context.

classes.name: LogUtil.MdcField
classes.description: Interface representing a MDC field with a name and value.

classes.name: LogUtil.ImmutableMdcField
classes.description: Immutable implementation of MdcField, encapsulating a name and optional value.

methods.name: obtain
methods.description: Creates a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter for a given Akka Actor.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationId
methods.description: Enhances a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter with a correlation ID extracted from headers or directly provided.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdOrRandom
methods.description: Enhances MDC with a correlation ID or generates a random one if absent.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCustomField
methods.description: Adds a custom field to the MDC of a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation ID from MDC.

methods.name: removeCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from MDC.

methods.name: removeCustomField
methods.description: Removes a specified custom field from MDC.

methods.name: newMdcField
methods.description: Creates a new MDC field with a name and optional value.
